title: acer orientale var. rotundifolium
intro: Acer orientale var. rotundifolium, commonly known as the Round-leaved Oriental Maple, is a deciduous shrub or small tree native to Asia. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, helping to relieve fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of this plant include expectorant, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic properties, which help to reduce inflammation, relieve congestion, and prevent infections. The bioactive constituents of the Round-leaved Oriental Maple include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
